instruction: Configure an email signature in Thunderbird with your name "David Thompson" on the first line, followed by "Customer Support Specialist" on the second line.

metadata.explanation: Task requires setting up a two-line signature in Thunderbird. The evaluator checks if mail.identity.id1.htmlSigText contains 'David Thompson' and 'Customer Support Specialist' on separate lines. Uses regex with re.S flag to match the pattern.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter logic correctly extracts prefs.js file from VM using get_vm_file
Metric function check_thunderbird_prefs correctly parses Thunderbird preference file format
Expected value uses correct preference key 'mail.identity.id1.htmlSigText' for signature text
Pattern 'David Thompson\\nCustomer Support Specialist' correctly represents two-line signature with newline
Method 're.S' enables proper regex matching for the pattern
Postconfig appropriately closes Thunderbird and waits 0.5s to ensure prefs.js is flushed to disk
Complete coverage: evaluator verifies both required lines in correct order
Parameter handling is correct: function parameter 'rule' receives rules dict directly (not 'expected')
Edge cases handled: returns 0.0 if file is None or missing

rule_validation_issues.msg: metric check_thunderbird_prefs first parameter type (str) may not match getter get_vm_file return type (Union)
